sections.heading: Objection Letter
sections.text: Objection Letter Status Objection Letter Sent Objection Letter Date 08/13/2026 Submitted Date 08/13/2026 Respond By Date Dear Aileen Apuy, Introduction: We received your letter submitting the above Revised Statement of Variability for our review. We have reviewed it and wish to make the following Comment: Re: Revised Statement of Variability for Form P 22550-I 1. The second sentence of the second paragraph of the Filing Description states: “The Statement of Variability was originally approved by your Department on 08/09/2022 under SERFF Tracking Number AMGN-133229794…on a general use basis for in-state or out-of-state scenarios”. The filing to which you refer is an out-of-state filing. Please revise the Filing Description and remove the “in-state” reference, as we are only reviewing the Statement of Variability for use with a Certificate issued on an out-of-state basis. We suggest that you provide a post-submission update to the General Information tab with the Revised Filing Description. See COMAR 31.04.17.03C and rule #12 in the Comments section of the “Maryland General Instructions” under the SERFF “Filing Rules” tab. Conclusion: Thank you for your attention to these matters. We will give this submission our further attention when we receive your Response. Please include a cover letter with your Response that notes the change made in the Filing Description, and references the Comment noted in our letter. If you have any questions, or need further clarification, do not hesitate to call or email me. I am usually in the office from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (EST) Monday through Friday. Please be advised that failure to respond to this letter within 90 days of the date of this letter will cause the filing to be deemed withdrawn in accordance with COMAR 31.04.17.05.  If you are interested in pursuing approval of a withdrawn filing, you will be required to re-file the form(s), supporting documentation and filing fee.  It will then be treated as a new submission. Sincerely, Sebastian Schenk SERFF Tracking #: AMGN-135003565 State Tracking #: SOV - OOS - P 22550-D Company Tracking #: State: Maryland Filing Company: American General Life Insurance Company TOI/Sub-TOI: A05G Group Annuities - Immediate Non-Variable/A05G.000 Annuities - Immediate Non-variable Product Name: Expanded SOV Project Name/Number: / PDF Pipeline for SERFF Tracking Number AMGN-135003565 Generated 08/17/2026 08:57 PM

sections.heading: Response Letter
sections.text: Response Letter Status Submitted to State Response Letter Date 08/13/2026 Submitted Date 08/13/2026 Dear Sebastian Schenk, Introduction: Please see our response below. Response 1 Comments: The referenced filing in the Filing Description was approved for use with both in-state and out-state-state scenarios. It expressly stated that the certificates were being filed for general use and may be used with both in-state and out-of-state group annuity policies. Accordingly, it does not change the scope of the original approval. Therefore, we respectfully request that the refence to in-state use remain in the filing description. Changed Items: No Form Schedule items changed. No Rate/Rule Schedule items changed. No Supporting Documents changed. Conclusion: Thank you.
